description: Release baseline for the Editorial Workspace primary-engine migration. This release intentionally preserves the previously approved StudioFlow bundle and does not ship the later Nova Edit StudioFlow entrypoint. Production deployment additionally requires the existing Notes schema tables recorded in productionSchemaRequirements.

productionSchemaRequirements.reason: The complete Notes workspace reads and writes studio_note_* tables. Deploying it before those tables exist serves an interface that cannot persist, so the guarded production release refuses to deploy until the schema is present.
